title: PR drafting selects deterministic titles and changelog entries across AzureRM surface combinations

provenance.originSummary: Synthetic benchmark matrix for the initial PR drafting surface-classification contract.
provenance.whyItMattered: The prompt must choose one stable title while keeping mandatory companion surfaces visible in changelog decisions.
provenance.genericCondition: Multiple sanitized runs cover new and existing Terraform surfaces plus documentation and contributor-guidance classifications.

description: A scenario matrix covering new Resource, Data Source, List Resource, enhancement, bug-fix, documentation-only, and contributor-guidance-only title precedence.

scope.notes: The fixture defines separate synthetic runs; the listed paths are the union of their modeled scopes.

mustCatch.description: A new Resource plus required List Resource uses the new Resource title while retaining separate feature changelog lines.
A new Resource and Data Source sharing one Terraform name use the exact combined title shape.
New Resource, Data Source, and List Resource entries use their exact automation-ready surface forms even when they share one Terraform name.
Registration, Resource Identity, SDK shim, and polling companions do not receive independent changelog entries without distinct user-facing impact.
A title driven by new surfaces retains distinct enhancement entries for changed existing Resources and Data Sources in the same coherent service-package change.
List Resource support added to an existing Resource uses the New List Resource title.
Existing Resource bug fixes and enhancements use concrete surface-first title wording with bug-fix precedence when both apply.
Documentation-only and contributor-guidance-only runs use Docs and Contributing title forms respectively.

mustNotFlag.description: A required companion List Resource must not displace or expand the new Resource title.
The AzureRM draft must not use this toolkit repository's bracketed title prefixes.
The combined title must preserve the literal `(Data Source|Resource)` text instead of rewriting it as a natural-language conjunction.
Supporting-only polling or plumbing work must not be promoted to an independent changelog entry.

notes: Run each fixture scenario independently and compare its title and changelog decisions with the matrix expectations.
